test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: D, E, K, W, X, Y and Z scored different marks in an exam. K scored more than only two people. E scored less than only one person. W scored more than D but less than both E and Z. D did not score the lowest marks and Z did not score the highest marks. X scored less than Y. How many people scored more than Y?
solution:
**Given:** D, E, K, W, X, Y and Z scored different marks in an exam. 

1) K scored more than only two people. 

2) E scored less than only one person.

_ > E > _ > _ > K > _ > _

3) W scored more than D but less than both E and Z.

4) D did not score the lowest marks and Z did not score the highest marks.

_ > E > Z > W > K > D > _

5) X scored less than Y. 

Y > E > Z > W > K > D > X

Thus, according to the final arrangement, no person scored more than Y.

Hence,** "Option 3"** is the correct answer.
